events.name: New England Patriots at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 303 yards and one touchdown, and New England's porous defense showed signs of improvement Thursday night in a 19-14 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws for 303 yards, Patriots hold off Bucs 19-14

headlines.description: A.J. Green had a hand in three turnovers that kept it close, but the receiver also pulled off a 77-yard touchdown and another long catch that set up a score Sunday, rallying the Cincinnati Bengals to a 20-16 victory over the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Green's big game rallies Bengals over Bills 20-16 in rain

events.name: New York Jets at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Josh McCown came back to Cleveland and beat the team that cut him, throwing two touchdown passes and leading the surprising New York Jets to a 17-14 win over the winless Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCown, surprising Jets soar past winless Browns 17-14

headlines.description: Cam Newton showed he was very focused on football, throwing three touchdowns to help the Carolina Panthers build a lead big enough to hold off the Detroit Lions for a 27-24 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Newton's 3 TD passes help Panthers beat Lions 27-24

headlines.description: The Indianapolis Colts scrapped the Peyton Manning playbook Sunday. Instead, they relied on ball control and patience.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts celebrate Manning's return with 26-23 win over 49ers

headlines.description: Jay Cutler finally silenced the boobirds with a fourth-quarter touchdown pass, and the Miami Dolphins overcame another dismal offensive showing Sunday to beat the Tennessee Titans 16-10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler silences boos with late TD as Dolphins beat Titans

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw a 10-yard touchdown pass to Melvin Gordon with 2:58 to play and the Los Angeles Chargers rallied to beat the New York Giants 27-22 on Sunday in a game worthy of two teams that started the season 0-4.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers end nine-game losing streak, Giants remain winless

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw a career-best four touchdown passes and the Philadelphia Eagles continued their impressive start with a 34-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz tosses 4 touchdown passes, Eagles beat Cardinals 34-7

headlines.description: The new-look Jacksonville Jaguars just might be for real.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pick 6s fuel Jaguars in sloppy 30-9 upset over Steelers

headlines.description: Joe Flacco hit Mike Wallace on two deep passes to spark Baltimore's struggling offense, and the Ravens got a fumble return for a touchdown by Jimmy Smith to beat the short-handed Oakland Raiders 30-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens beat Raiders without Carr 30-17

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams
Green Bay Packers at Dallas Cowboys
Kansas City Chiefs at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns to help the Kansas City Chiefs remain undefeated with a 42-34 victory over the Houston Texans on Sunday night in a game where J.J. Watt broke his left leg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Undefeated Chiefs beat Texans 42-34; Watt breaks left leg

headlines.description: Case Keenum led three second-half scoring drives in relief of Sam Bradford, and the Minnesota Vikings spoiled prized rookie quarterback Mitchell Trubisky's debut with a 20-17 victory over the Chicago Bears on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keenum leads 3 scoring drives, Vikings beat Bears 20-17
